meta.name: Computer Collection — portfolio DNA
meta.description: Light editorial archive in which eleven silver all-in-one computers are the gallery; each screen shows the real website it represents.
source_references: https://a24.raviklaassens.com/ (measured: body rgb(242,242,242), ink #000, 12px base at 1440, faces Ppeiko / PPNeueMontreal / Ppmuseum, diagonal disc rail, credits table top-left, review quotes at the foot, torn-edge detail page)
User CSS reference (1920 ideal container, fluid --size-font, heading scale xxl→xs at -0.04em, vh spacing scale)
User master prompt (ivory palette, iMac-style silver hardware, gallery behaviour)

color.palette_type: monochromatic warm-neutral; colour comes only from the website screenshots

primary.role: paper: the room the computers stand in (a touch cooler than cream, between A24's #F2F2F2 and the brief's #F5F3EE)

secondary.role: paper-deep: floor shadows, ledger hover, overlay plates

accent.role: ink as the only accent: primary action fill, focus ring, selected index tick

neutral.usage: FBFAF8 surface; F3F2EE ground; E8E6E0 tone steps; B9B7B0 aluminium reference; 6A6762 secondary text (5.0:1 on ground); 191919 text and actions

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant; secondary text tinted warm grey never below 4.5:1; colour reserved for the screens

font_families.heading: Bodoni Moda (OFL) — stands in for the reference's Ppeiko: high-contrast display serif, used only at display sizes
font_families.body: Hanken Grotesk (OFL) — stands in for PP Neue Montreal: neutral grotesk, covers ə ı ü ş ç ğ İ
font_families.mono: none (tabular figures of Hanken Grotesk for counters)

typography.font_style_notes: Two families. Serif only for project titles and the h1; every label, link and paragraph in the grotesk. Capitals only where the brief asks for them (nav, overline labels).

spacing.base_unit: 1em = --size-font (16px at 1920, fluid with the container, floor 992px)
spacing.content_density: spacious around the objects, compact inside labels
spacing.section_rhythm: sections separated by --space-m (21vh) on desktop; labels use 0.5–1em internal steps

layout.grid_system: 12 columns, 2em page padding (1.5em tablet, 1rem phone), 2em gutter
layout.max_content_width: 3840px container cap; text measures capped at 62ch
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric inside a symmetric frame: labels hang from the left margin, controls from the right

shape.border_usage: hairlines only inside label tables (the museum-label schema), never around blocks

elevation.shadow_style: none on UI; physical contact shadows only under the computers
elevation.depth_cues: real 3D perspective, receding scale, contact shadows on the paper floor

motion.entrance_pattern: objects already present; labels swap with a 12px rise and opacity
motion.philosophy: cinematic only on the one peak (opening a computer); everything else is exact feedback

components.button_style: square 2px corners; primary = ink fill with paper text; secondary = text link with offset underline
components.card_style: no cards — objects and label tables
components.navigation_pattern: plain header: name left, WORK / ABOUT / CONTACT right; collection index rail of 11 ticks
components.modal_style: full-screen project overlay on paper, opened by growing the selected screen
components.list_style: quiet ledger rows (title / category / year) with hover preview
components.component_notes: Every computer carries the same label schema: index, title, category, year, built with.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a curated shelf of hardware in a gallery; each machine is still switched on to the site it shipped
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary industrial design (aluminium, glass) with print-catalogue typography

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous; whitespace is the room around the objects
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: centre-heavy (the selected computer), labels at the lower-left and controls at the lower-right
visual_language.contrast_level: high for type, low for surfaces
visual_language.texture_usage: the aluminium and glass of the computers only

composition.flow_direction: horizontal in the collection, vertical elsewhere
composition.negative_space_role: the ivory room that makes the objects read as objects

imagery.photo_treatment: untreated real website captures, never redesigned
imagery.image_shape: screen rectangles with the display's own corner radius

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: links underline-offset change; ledger rows dim siblings; the selected screen scrolls its site
interaction_feel.loading_style: none (no loading screens); objects appear when textures arrive

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative (Open project, Visit live website)
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: say what is missing and where to add it

overview.fallback_strategy: no WebGL or reduced motion → static screenshots in CSS frames, instant transitions

background_effects.description: Flat paper ground. The canvas is transparent over it.

3d_elements.description: Eleven procedurally modelled all-in-one computers (aluminium body, glass display, bent stand) on an implied floor; screens carry the real site captures as textures.

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer, alpha, antialias, ACES tone mapping, DPR ≤ 2
params.lighting: PMREM RoomEnvironment for metal reflections + one soft key light
params.camera: perspective, fov 28, slightly above the screens' centre
params.materials: MeshPhysicalMaterial brushed aluminium (metalness 1, roughness .3), black glass bezel with clearcoat, unlit screen texture
params.geometry: rounded boxes, rounded-rect screen shapes, extruded stand profile
params.interaction_model: scroll / drag / keys move the shelf; pointer over the selected screen scrolls its site; click opens

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: collection pinned for (n-1) × 70vh; ledger rows on enter
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: scrubbed with lerp, snapping to the nearest computer

text_effects.description: Label swap: outgoing label rises out, incoming rises in, by line.

cursor_effects.description: native cursor; grab/grabbing over the shelf

image_effects.description: Opening a project grows the screen rectangle into the overlay hero (FLIP).

canvas_drawings.description: Contact shadows are pre-drawn radial textures.

visual_effects.composite_notes: One canvas renders all computers; screen textures load lazily nearest-first. Only the selected computer receives the tall full-page texture (for the look-through move) and only on fine pointers. The canvas pauses when the collection is off-screen or the overlay is open.
